{{- /* This file only renders combined tabs: labels + panels. The tab.html child shortcode stores data in .Parent.Store. See tab.html for per-tab logic. Uses CSS-only radio-button pattern. Radios are clipped (not hidden) so keyboard users can Tab to the group and use arrow keys to switch tabs. */ -}} {{- .Inner -}} {{- $tabs := .Store.Get "tabs" | default slice -}} {{- $id := printf "wvc-tabs-%d" .Ordinal -}}
{{- /* Radio inputs — visually clipped, still focusable. Screen readers announce them as "radio button, name, X of Y". Arrow keys change selection natively. */ -}} {{- range $i, $t := $tabs -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Tab labels — visual only. Clicking a label checks the corresponding radio via the for/id association. */ -}}
{{- range $i, $t := $tabs -}} {{- end -}}
{{- /* Tab panels */ -}}
{{- range $i, $t := $tabs -}}
{{ $t.content | safeHTML }}
{{- end -}}
